_: The King's sheet and his family (royal_sheet.gd; CK3's ruler window), opened from the bar's heading. Each line's words; {name}, {age}, {traits}, {house}, {how} are filled from /world royals (bridge royals.js). nature_tip: why his nature matters at court; regency: while a child is King; no_heir: with none; abdicate_tip: what stepping down does. trust: what his word is worth, by bands of the bridge's trust (0..1; the first whose above it clears): says on his sheet, pledge under a promise at court (the council's tone), low in red. stress: how he bears his rulings, by bands of royals.king.stress (from; the bridge's stress.high is 3): says on his sheet, grade the colour laid on his portrait.
none: The royal house is not yet known.
nature_tip: Lords of a like nature warm to him; those of the opposite nature cool. A new King is measured again by every lord.
regency: A child sits the throne. Until he comes of age the realm is held by a regent, and cold lords rise more readily.
no_heir: There is no heir. If the King dies so, the crown is up for the taking.
abdicate_tip: The heir is of age. The crown passes to him now, and every lord takes his measure afresh.
funeral: The great houses swore to the old King, not to this one. Old friends wait to be won again, and old grudges are half forgotten.
pledge_tag: Your word. Kept, it is remembered warmly; broken, bitterly.
news_broken: The King's word is broken: {text}. They will remember it.

trust.says: His word is good. The houses take it at its face.
trust.pledge: Your word. Kept, it is remembered warmly; broken, bitterly.

trust.says: His word is doubted. A promise warms them less than it did.
trust.pledge: Your word, Your Grace. They have heard it before, and weigh it.

trust.says: His word is wind. The houses hear a promise and wait to see it done.
trust.pledge: Your word? The Hand would not lean on it; the houses have learned not to.

stress.says: He sleeps badly. What he has ruled against his own nature is wearing him down, and it may shorten his days.
Some of his rulings sit ill with him.

rest._: Easing the King's mind on his sheet (bridge royals.js rest: the gold, ease and seasons are the bridge's): each kind's button word, its hover line and what is said when done; again ({n}) and poor on a locked one.
rest.head: Ease his mind

hunt.label: Hunt
hunt.tip: A day in the royal forest eases him. Once a year; a fall from the saddle is not unknown.
hunt.done: The King rides out to hunt.

feast.label: Feast
feast.tip: A feast in the great hall eases him, and every great house warms a little. Once a year.
feast.done: The great hall is made ready for a feast.

pilgrimage.label: Pilgrimage
pilgrimage.tip: Barefoot to the old shrine: it eases him most, and the pious lords warm to him. Once in two years.
pilgrimage.done: The King sets out on pilgrimage.

rest.again: Not again so soon: in {n} seasons.
rest.poor: The treasury holds too little for this.
